data.title: 夏洛特 · 度假阳台的系带解开
data.description: 滨海度假套房阳台上，落日将天空染成火红。法式吊带裙背后的系带已被解开，夏洛特背靠栏杆仰头承受深吻，金发在海风中飘动，呼吸急促而甜腻。
data.location: private resort hotel balcony overlooking sea at sunset
data.action: pinned gently against balcony railing, sundress unzipped at back, head tilted in deep French kiss, sea breeze blowing hair
data.lighting: dramatic golden hour sunset rim light on bare shoulders and waves
data.mood: passionate sunset surrender, breathless romantic indulgence, ocean breeze heat
data.promptProse: Backed against a resort balcony railing in sunset glow, Charlotte tilts her head in a breathless kiss as her dress unlaces at the back.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte sharing a breathless passionate kiss on a resort balcony at sunset.
